name: F-22 Air Dominance Fighter
storyline: You have control over up to 4 F-22 ADFs. or an AWACS. With the F-22 you fly miscellaneous missions such as air-to-ground or air-to-air or protect the AWACS around the war zone. If the AWACS are down you are sightless, making the mission harder to complete. From the AWACS you have control over all aircraft and you can send out commands to protect an aircraft or attack the enemy.
summary: F-22 Air Dominance Fighter is a military flight simulation that recreates the experience of piloting America's advanced fighter aircraft. The game features 20 training missions, including takeoffs, landings, mid-air refueling, and combat scenarios, alongside three campaign tours set across the Red Sea, Eritrea, and Saudi Arabia. Players engage in missions using authentic avionics and weapon systems while navigating diverse terrain from deserts to valleys.
